# Shoryavardhaan Gupta

> Builder and developer from Kolkata, India (born 2 Sep 2009), shipping civic tech, hardware and AI projects since age 14. India Innovates 2026: Top 1,000 of 26,000+ entries. Kolkata Fork Lead at Bits&Bytes, Youth Partner at 4MQ.org, freelance UI & landing page designer.

The homepage (https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/) is an interactive 3D room rendered in the browser, so it has little readable text. Everything in it is also available as text: this file, the pages linked below, a terminal version at /terminal/, and JSON at /api/cli/*. Every project links to its public GitHub repository, so claims can be checked at the source.

## Projects

- [Buy4Chai](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/project/buy4chai): Self-hosted supporter page for developers Stripe locked out of. Razorpay and UPI, zero platform fees, MIT license. Source: https://github.com/vassu-v/Buy4Chai · Live: https://land-chai.vercel.app/
- [SarkarSathi](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/project/sarkarsathi): AI co-pilot for municipal accountability in India: commitment tracking, complaint clustering and governance intelligence for elected representatives. India Innovates 2026, Top 1,000 of 26,000+ entries. Source: https://github.com/vassu-v/india-innovates-CivicNTech
- [Disaster-Resilient LiFi Network](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/project/lifi-network): Off-grid IR mesh that turns solar street lamps into emergency communication nodes. CBSE Regional Science Exhibition 2025–26. Source: https://github.com/vassu-v/D-LiFi-Proto
- [ChemX](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/project/chemx): Physical chemistry reaction simulator controlled from a browser, built on Arduino. Source: https://github.com/vassu-v/ChemX_001
- [Grounded Planning Research](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/project/planning-research): Explicit object commitment in non-linguistic agent planning, published on Zenodo. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19513284. Source: https://github.com/vassu-v/action-vs-object-planning

## Side projects

- [Tackety](https://github.com/vassu-v/Tackety): Open-source, self-hostable support engine that clusters similar issues and ranks them by real impact. In development.
- [S.H.O.A.V.](https://github.com/vassu-v/SHOAV): MCP server that gives AI agents a real browser with a deterministic guard against clickjacking, dark patterns and hidden prompt injection. Genesis Hackathon 2026, Track 03. Live: https://shoav.vercel.app/
- [Switchyard](https://github.com/vassu-v/agent-supervisor-multiprovider_mcp): Local daemon that keeps one live session per coding agent (agy, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex) and steers them from one CLI, MCP bridge or dashboard.
- [Delhi CM Dashboard](https://github.com/vassu-v/delhi-cm-dashboard-hn): SarkarSathi spin-off: grievance command centre with complaint clustering, surge alerts and an AI advisor.
- [FitHub](https://github.com/vassu-v/FitHub): Gamified fitness tracker for students using a phone or a DIY sensor band. Built in 3 hours.

## Writing

- [A 3D room on a laptop with no graphics card](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/pixel-budget): How this site's 3D homepage went from 95 ms to 6.7 ms per frame on integrated graphics, and why each visitor gets a pixel budget.
- [Nobody told me to start. That was the point.](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/why-i-build): Three years of shipping real things from Kolkata, and starting before you're supposed to.
- [Why Indian developers can't get paid online, and how I fixed it](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/building-buy4chai): How a Reddit thread confirmed the gap was real, and building Buy4Chai to fill it.
- [Markets don't get disrupted. They get aged out.](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/markets-dont-get-disrupted): Why the quiet danger isn't AI taking jobs.
- [Apple's been playing a different game since 2017](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/apple-ai-decade): How Apple built AI silicon before AI was the thing to build for.
- [Both groups are losing. Just differently.](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/both-groups-are-losing): Students who ship without understanding vs. students who learn syntax while the world moves on.
- [Why "needs vs. wants" is the wrong framework](https://shoryavardhaan.vercel.app/blog/hardware-failure): Financial literacy for a generation running on algorithmic desire engines.
